# Camp Buff Item: Stargazer's Telescope

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Apr 11, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c1140d16c6ad4905a7eae73d047c1a2d~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

The buffs you receive from these camp items will stack with buffs from food, chems, drinks, armor, and other sources.

However, you cannot stack multiple camp items that provide the same buff—for example, two items that both grant Luck or Intelligence will not stack. Additionally, camp item buffs do not stack with themselves.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Stargazer's Telescope__

Image Credit: SugarBombs.Rads

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e616114525ac4cd9b7dfd46b07a0e15f~mv2.jpg)

**Buff:**

+2 Perception

**Lasts for:**

30 minutes

**Player animation:**

Yes

**Build limit per camp**

None

**Build limit per workshop**

None

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Floor Decor

**Materials required to craft resource**

3x Steel

**Holds**

N/A

**Obtainable via**

In-Game

Purchase the plan from Ineke in Milepost Zero, once you have upgraded her to Tier 2.

The plan is non-tradeable

This camp item can be built in other people's camps

**Produces X amount per**

N/A

**Lockable**

N/A

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
